🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Consumer Cycle ↑ rising (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND and Semis strength via SOXX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +45.75%) ABOVE TREND, offset by credit stress signal HYG/LQD ↓ (credit stress rising).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ↓ (credit stress rising) while VXX (1W: -3.27% | 1M: -19.85%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling signals lower fear; Stocks vs Bonds ratio ↑ rising (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +9.21%) ABOVE TREND supports equity leadership.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Yield curve RECOVERY (1W: +0.83% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY → flat and Duration Preference RECOVERY → flat; Dollar UUP (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.44%) BELOW TREND showing mild USD weakness.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech-led: XLK (1W: +6.86% | 1M: +23.72%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +45.75%) ABOVE TREND showing momentum; Energy weak: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND — style: Growth/Momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?  
US strength via SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +18.21%) ABOVE TREND, while EM is also strong: EEM (1W: +7.66% | 1M: +17.76%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND; China tech metrics remain soft relative to US.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation elevated: IWM (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +13.40%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +8.23% | 1M: +15.74%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +18.13%) ABOVE TREND show healthy risk-on flows.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial metals leading: CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND; Gold GLD (1W: +3.25% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY—pocketed safe-haven interest.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy soft: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -8.98% | 1M: +0.02%) CORRECTION; nat gas UNG (1W: +2.96% | 1M: -9.52%) RECOVERY showing mixed regional drivers.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis leadership (XLK and SOXX both ABOVE TREND) and breadth strong (10/11). DIVERGENCE: XLF shows 1W negative vs 1M positive (CORRECTION) and HYG/LQD ↓ flags rising credit stress—monitor for spillover.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposure (XLK (1W: +6.86% | 1M: +23.72%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +45.75%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to energy (XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND); monitor credit (HYG/LQD ↓) and XLF correction for rotation risk.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology (XLK (1W: +6.86% | 1M: +23.72%) ABOVE TREND) and Semiconductors (SOXX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +45.75%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Energy (XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -5.25%) BELOW TREND) and cyclically vulnerable pockets if credit stress widens.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals (CPER (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND) and Silver (SLV (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Brent/oil volatility (BNO (1W: -8.98% | 1M: +0.02%) CORRECTION) and energy complex (XLE BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 marks complacency (VXX (1W: -3.27% | 1M: -19.85%) BELOW TREND); HYG/LQD tipping point ~0.80 for credit health (HYG/LQD ↓); XLK/XLF spread ~3.28 is the growth vs value pivot; SPY short-term trend confirmed while below next technical support would signal rotation pressure.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, cycle signals (consumer and semis) intact while risk signals are mixed. Technology and semiconductors showing strength — XLK (1W: +6.86% | 1M: +23.72%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +45.75%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk is rising credit stress (HYG/LQD ↓) and XLF correction — monitor credit spreads and financials for spillover.
